findings.highlight: It’s sad, but I guess all I can do is stay here.
findings.evidenceJa: 悔しいが、ここに留まるしかない
findings.governingReading: Shirou is frustrated and humiliated that he has no useful choice but to remain behind.
findings.explanation: Sadness replaces self-directed frustration at his inability to support Saber.

findings.highlight: Sixty seconds pass.
findings.evidenceJa: 肌に張り付くような六十秒
findings.governingReading: Sixty seconds seem to cling to Shirou’s skin as he waits.
findings.explanation: The English preserves elapsed time but removes the oppressive tactile duration of helpless waiting.

findings.highlight: a few hundred meters higher
findings.evidenceJa: 地上百メートルもの高み
findings.governingReading: The lights disappear toward the rooftop roughly one hundred meters above ground.
findings.explanation: A few hundred multiplies the stated height and materially distorts the building’s scale.

findings.highlight: It repeats in rapid succession.
findings.evidenceJa: 矢継ぎ早に、振り子のように繰り返される
findings.governingReading: The light repeats rapidly, swinging back and forth like a pendulum.
findings.explanation: The English omits the pendular pattern that distinguishes repeated traversals from generic flashes.

findings.highlight: Gritting my teeth at my cowardice
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の不甲斐なさに歯噛みしながら
findings.governingReading: Shirou grits his teeth at his own helpless inadequacy as he runs.
findings.explanation: Cowardice falsely makes fear or moral timidity the problem when he delayed because he lacked a useful means to intervene.

findings.highlight: In the darkness of the inactive lights
findings.evidenceJa: 電灯の消えた暗闇の中
findings.governingReading: He continues through darkness where the electric lights are out.
findings.explanation: Inactive lights is unnatural and obscures the concrete unlit stairwell.

findings.highlight: That couldn’t be Rider’s Noble Phantasm…!?
findings.evidenceJa: 今の、ライダーの宝具じゃないぞ
findings.governingReading: Shirou recognizes that the impact just felt was not Rider’s Noble Phantasm.
findings.explanation: Couldn’t be recasts a present recognition as incredulous speculation and weakens the branch’s information state.

findings.highlight: A dry air as if there is nothing living.
findings.evidenceJa: 生きている者など存在しない、乾いた空気
findings.governingReading: The rooftop air is so dry that no living thing could exist in it.
findings.explanation: The English describes apparent absence rather than an environment felt as incompatible with life.

findings.highlight: Saber won’t get well
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの体も良くならないし
findings.governingReading: Removing Saber’s armor and laying her down did not improve her body.
findings.explanation: Won’t get well turns Rin’s statement that her aid produced no improvement into a categorical prediction of future nonrecovery.

findings.highlight: a fish puffing because it doesn’t have enough oxygen
findings.evidenceJa: 酸素不足で喘いでいる魚
findings.governingReading: Saber is like a fish gasping for lack of oxygen.
findings.explanation: Puffing suggests inflation or mild exertion and weakens the image of acute respiratory distress.

findings.highlight: ways to heal a Servant
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントを元に戻す方法
findings.governingReading: Rin names two ways to restore a Servant who has exhausted her magical energy.
findings.explanation: Heal frames depletion as a wound or illness rather than replenishing the energy required to maintain existence.

findings.highlight: absorb their souls
findings.evidenceJa: 魂を食べさせなさい
findings.governingReading: Rin tells Shirou to make Saber attack people and feed on their souls.
findings.explanation: Absorb replaces the predatory act of eating that makes the proposed method morally and emotionally repellent.

findings.highlight: I still feel her body heat in my hands which were carrying her.
findings.evidenceJa: この手には、さっきまで抱いていた彼女の体温が残っている
findings.governingReading: The hand that held Saber until moments ago still retains her body heat.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the focal hand, turns an embracing hold into carrying, and produces a malformed relative clause.

findings.highlight: How selfish of me
findings.evidenceJa: 何を、都合のいい事を
findings.governingReading: Shirou rebukes himself for entertaining a self-serving, conveniently hopeful thought.
findings.explanation: Selfish turns motivated wishful thinking into a broader moral accusation and changes the precise fault he identifies.

findings.highlight: a serious expression
findings.evidenceJa: 浮かない顔
findings.governingReading: Illya asks why Shirou looks gloomy or downcast.
findings.explanation: Serious loses the visible unhappiness that prompts her question.

findings.highlight: I’m amazed at my stupidity.
findings.evidenceJa: 何をしているのかと呆れてしまった
findings.governingReading: Shirou becomes exasperated with himself for reflexively warning an enemy Master about danger.
findings.explanation: Amazed is the wrong emotional relation and makes the reaction sound impressed or surprised.

findings.highlight: You know you don’t have any protection, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 守りも何もないんだもの
findings.governingReading: Illya observes that Shirou has no defenses whatsoever.
findings.explanation: The English turns her delighted assessment into a rhetorical reminder directed at him, weakening her predatory confidence.

findings.highlight: I didn’t come here today to talk either.
findings.evidenceJa: 今日はお話をしにきたワケじゃないもの
findings.governingReading: Illya says she did not come to talk today, closing the spoken line before the narration resumes.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the quotation unclosed, obscuring the boundary between her threat and narration.

findings.highlight: Murderous intent seeps in into Illya’s gaze.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの視線に殺気が灯る
findings.governingReading: Murderous intent kindles in Illya’s gaze.
findings.explanation: Seeps in into is grammatically malformed and weakens the sudden ignition marking her return to the Berserker Master persona.

findings.highlight: Her white slender fingers touch my chest.
findings.evidenceJa: ひたり、と俺の胸に触れた
findings.governingReading: Illya’s slender white fingers settle deliberately and closely against Shirou’s chest.
findings.explanation: The English omits the quiet, unnerving contact texture of ひたり.

findings.highlight: My vision fades.
findings.evidenceJa: 視界が途切れた
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s vision cuts out; only after time in complete darkness does his consciousness finally snap off.
findings.explanation: Fades changes the first abrupt cutoff into a gradual one and weakens the ordered sensory shutdown.

findings.highlight: this is only a natural privilege
findings.evidenceJa: これは当然の権利なんだから
findings.governingReading: Illya insists that what she is doing is her rightful entitlement after waiting ten years.
findings.explanation: Natural privilege is unnatural English and shifts her claimed right into a granted social advantage.

findings.highlight: the preparation for acceptance of the prime field
findings.evidenceJa: 素体の受け入れ準備
findings.governingReading: Sella reports that preparations for the base body or vessel to receive the transfer are complete.
findings.explanation: Prime field is a categorical mistranslation that conceals the physical recipient and makes the transfer procedure unintelligible.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what will happen to me in the next few minutes
findings.evidenceJa: 数分の後、自分がどうなるかは判らない
findings.governingReading: Shirou does not know what state he will be in several minutes later.
findings.explanation: In the next few minutes changes the reference point from the resulting state after an interval to events occurring during the interval.
